en.privacy-policy.html:
PAIA

Privacy policy

Policy content last updated: 2026-10-13

IN THIS DOCUMENT1. Core principles2. AI-related data use3. This website4. Contact form5. Services and policy updates6. User control and deletion

1. Core principles

PAIA currently operates local-first. Core archive data is stored on the user’s device by default. Everyday capture, search, editing, manual management and prompt reuse happen locally.

2. AI-related data use

PAIA does not give external AI your complete archive by default. Processing requires permission and only the necessary material. Automatic maintenance follows your settings; generation is initiated by you. Context reading permissions are separate, and connecting does not open cards or topics automatically.

3. This website

This website introduces PAIA, provides an interactive demo and offers help. It does not connect to your PAIA archive or install analytics or behavioral trackers.

4. Contact form

The contact form uses FormSubmit to send the information you enter to haohongfei2001@gmail.com, solely to respond to your inquiry. It is deleted when no longer needed. You may request earlier deletion through that email. Do not submit sensitive information.

5. Services and policy updates

When services, data structures or optional features change, their data boundaries will be explained and this policy updated before activation. A website demonstration or an upgrade does not authorize access to your archive.

6. User control and deletion

You remain in control of viewing, editing, permissions and deletion. Available features and supported environments are described at the installation entry and in Help.

7. Contact

For policy, service or message-deletion questions, contact haohongfei2001@gmail.com.

Website sample clarification: inputs are used only in current-page memory, not uploaded or persisted, and clear on reload. Website hosting and FormSubmit have their own data-processing boundaries.

en.terms.html:
PAIA

Terms

Policy content last updated: 2026-10-13

IN THIS DOCUMENT1. Before using PAIA2. User data3. Backups4. Acceptable use5. Third-party services6. Availability and limitations

1. Before using PAIA

Check the supported environment and permissions before installing. This website’s interactive demo is separate from the installed product, does not connect to personal archives and does not activate any service.

2. User data

Users retain the relevant rights in content they enter, edit and import. PAIA provides viewing, editing and management, not content exports or generation of new backups.

3. Backups

Do not use PAIA as the only copy of important data. Retain the original platform or another independent source for material that needs long-term preservation.

4. Acceptable use

Do not use PAIA for unlawful activity, unauthorized data collection, violations of others’ privacy or intellectual property, or circumvention of third-party access and usage restrictions.

5. Third-party services

PAIA may work with browsers, AI services and other third-party platforms. PAIA does not control their availability, terms or technical changes, which may require changes to related features.

6. Availability and limitations

Services are used as provided, without a promise of continuous, error-free or permanent availability. PAIA seeks to reduce data risks; keep an independent copy of important material.

7. Contact

For policy, service or message-deletion questions, contact haohongfei2001@gmail.com.

zh.privacy-policy.html:
PAIA

隐私政策

政策内容最后更新: 2026-10-13

阅读本页1. 核心原则2. AI 相关数据使用3. 本网站4. 联系表单5. 服务与政策更新6. 用户控制与删除

1. 核心原则

PAIA 当前以本地优先方式运行。核心档案数据默认保存在用户设备上，日常保存、检索、编辑、手动管理与提示词复用在本地完成。

2. AI 相关数据使用

PAIA 不默认把完整档案交给外部 AI。外部 AI 处理须先获得相应许可，并仅使用必要材料。自动维护按用户选择的设置运行，主动生成由用户发起。AI Context 的读取许可由用户分别控制；连接不会自动开放卡片或主题。

3. 本网站

本网站用于介绍 PAIA、提供交互演示与使用帮助，不连接用户的 PAIA 档案，也不设置分析脚本或行为跟踪器。

4. 联系表单

联系表单通过 FormSubmit 将你主动填写的信息发送至 haohongfei2001@gmail.com，仅用于回应本次联系，并在不再需要时删除。你可以通过该邮箱要求提前删除留言。请不要提交敏感信息。

5. 服务与政策更新

服务、数据结构与可选功能发生变化时，会在相应服务启用前说明数据处理范围并更新本政策。未经相应许可，不会因网站展示或功能升级自动开放你的档案。

6. 用户控制与删除

用户保留对自己档案的控制，包括查看、编辑、管理允许范围和删除。可用功能和支持环境以安装入口与使用帮助中的说明为准。

7. 联系

有关本政策、服务或留言删除的问题，请联系 haohongfei2001@gmail.com。

网站示例补充说明：示例输入只在当前页面内存中使用，不上传或持久保存；刷新即清除。网站托管和 FormSubmit 仍有各自的数据处理边界。

zh.terms.html:
PAIA

使用条款

政策内容最后更新: 2026-10-13

阅读本页1. 使用前2. 用户数据3. 备份责任4. 合理使用5. 第三方服务6. 可用性与责任边界

1. 使用前

使用前请核对安装入口的支持环境和权限说明。本网站的交互演示独立于安装后的产品，不连接个人档案，也不构成任何服务的自动开通。

2. 用户数据

用户对自己输入、编辑和导入的内容保留相应权利。PAIA 提供内容查看、编辑与管理；不提供内容导出或生成新备份。

3. 备份责任

请勿将 PAIA 作为重要数据的唯一副本。对于需要长期保存的内容，请同时保留原平台或其他独立来源。

4. 合理使用

请勿利用 PAIA 进行违法活动、未经授权的数据收集、侵犯他人隐私或知识产权，或规避第三方平台的访问和使用限制。

5. 第三方服务

PAIA 可能与浏览器、AI 服务或其他第三方平台配合使用。第三方服务的可用性、条款和技术变化不由 PAIA 控制，相关功能可能因此调整。

6. 可用性与责任边界

服务按其实际提供的状态使用，不承诺持续、无错误或永久可用。PAIA 致力于降低数据风险；重要资料仍应保留独立副本。

7. 联系

有关本政策、服务或留言删除的问题，请联系 haohongfei2001@gmail.com。
